title: Playboy Magazine December 1970 Gala Christmas Buckley Brautigan Silverstein
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. These 1970 issues show age and storage wear including cover wear, creasing, edge/corner wear and discoloration. Please review the photo for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, December 1970 - Gala Christmas Issue. Cover price $1.50.

Features:
- Masters and Johnson debunking the ten greatest sex myths
- William F. Buckley, Jr. marching through Russia
- A revealing interview with Robert Graves
- The Mafia "Exposed", by Murray Kempton
- Three tales by Richard Brautigan
- Movie Sex Stars of 1970
- The Underground Comix
- An exclusive work of art you can assemble
- Plus humor by P. G. Wodehouse, Jean Shepherd, Shel Silverstein, Dan Blocker and Tomi Ungerer
